lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir sa(n)g kaaman jaaniaa gur mel milaaee raam ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride knows that her Husband Lord is with her; the Guru unites her in this union.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar sabad milee sahaje tapat bujhaaee raam ||
lines.translation: Within her heart, she is merged with the Shabad, and the fire of her desire is easily extinguished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad tapat bujhaaee a(n)tar saa(n)t aaee sahaje har ras chaakhiaa ||
lines.translation: The Shabad has quenched the fire of desire, and within her heart, peace and tranquility have come; she tastes the Lord's essence with intuitive ease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਪਣੇ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil preetam apane sadaa ra(n)g maane sachai sabad subhaakhiaa ||
lines.translation: Meeting her Beloved, she enjoys His Love continually, and her speech rings with the True Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਾਕੇ ਭੇਖੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paR paR pa(n)dit monee thaake bhekhee mukat na paaee ||
lines.translation: Reading and studying continually, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages have grown weary; wearing religious robes, liberation is not obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bin bhagatee jag bauraanaa sachai sabad milaaee ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without devotional worship, the world has gone insane; through the True Word of the Shabad, one meets the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa dhan man anad bhaiaa har jeeu mel piaare raam ||
lines.translation: Bliss permeates the mind of the soul-bride, who meets her Beloved Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰਸਿ ਰਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa dhan har kai ras rasee gur kai sabad apaare raam ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride is enraptured with the sublime essence of the Lord, through the incomparable Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad apaare mile piaare sadaa gun saare man vase ||
lines.translation: Through the incomparable Word of the Guru's Shabad, she meets her Beloved; she continually contemplates and enshrines His Glorious Virtues in her mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਾ ਪਿਰਿ ਰਾਵੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਵਗਣ ਨਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sej suhaavee jaa pir raavee mil preetam avagan nase ||
lines.translation: Her bed was adorned when she enjoyed her Husband Lord; meeting with her Beloved, her demerits were erased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit ghar naam har sadaa dhiaaeeai sohilaRaa jug chaare ||
lines.translation: That house, within which the Lord's Name is continually meditated upon, resounds with the wedding songs of rejoicing, throughout the four ages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate sadaa anad hai har miliaa kaaraj saare ||4||1||6||
lines.translation: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, we are in bliss forever; meeting the Lord, our affairs are resolved. ||4||1||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 chha(n)t ghar 3 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehl, Chhant, Third House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਸਹ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਹੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: saajan mere preetamahu tum sah kee bhagat kareho ||
lines.translation: O my beloved friend, dedicate yourself to the devotional worship of your Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲੇਹੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevahu sadaa aapanaa naam padaarath leho ||
lines.translation: Serve your Guru constantly, and obtain the wealth of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਸਹੈ ਕੇਰੀ ਜੋ ਸਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat karahu tum sahai keree jo sah piaare bhaavae ||
lines.translation: Dedicate yourself to the worship of your Husband Lord; this is pleasing to your Beloved Husband.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਤਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਸਹ ਖੁਸੀ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaa bhaanaa tum karahu taa phir sah khusee na aavae ||
lines.translation: If you walk in accordance with your own will, then your Husband Lord will not be pleased with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਵ ਇਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਕੋ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat bhaav ihu maarag bikhaRaa gur duaarai ko paavae ||
lines.translation: This path of loving devotional worship is very difficult; how rare are those who find it, through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak jis kare kirapaa so har bhagatee chit laavae ||1||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, that one, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, links his consciousness to the worship of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਆ ਤੂੰ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man bairaageeaa too(n) bairaag kar kis dikhaavahi ||
lines.translation: O my detached mind, unto whom do you show your detachment?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਤਿਨੑ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sohilaa tinh sad sadaa jo har gun gaavahi ||
lines.translation: Those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord live in the joy of the Lord, forever and ever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਤੂੰ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar bairaag too(n) chhod paakha(n)d so sahu sabh kichh jaanae ||
lines.translation: So become detached, and renounce hypocrisy; Your Husband Lord knows everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal maheeal eko soee guramukh hukam pachhaanae ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is pervading the water, the land and the sky; the Gurmukh realizes the Command of His Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹਰੀ ਕੇਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin hukam pachhaataa haree keraa soee sarab sukh paavae ||
lines.translation: One who realizes the Lord's Command, obtains all peace and comforts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਵ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੋ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: iv kahai naanak so bairaagee anadin har liv laavae ||2||
lines.translation: Thus says Nanak: such a detached soul remains absorbed in the Lord's Love, day and night. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah jah man too(n) dhaavadaa tah tah har terai naale ||
lines.translation: Wherever you wander, O my mind, the Lord is there with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man siaanap chhodeeai gur kaa sabad samaale ||
lines.translation: Renounce your cleverness, O my mind, and reflect upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਥਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saath terai so sahu sadaa hai ik khin har naam samaalahe ||
lines.translation: Your Husband Lord is always with you, if you remember the Lord's Name, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਟੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam ke tere paap kate a(n)t param pad paavahe ||
lines.translation: The sins of countless incarnations shall be washed away, and in the end, you shall obtain the supreme status.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਗੰਢੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saache naal teraa ga(n)dh laagai guramukh sadaa samaale ||
lines.translation: You shall be linked to the True Lord, and as Gurmukh, remember Him forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਹ ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਧਾਵਦਾ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: iu kahai naanak jah man too(n) dhaavadaa tah har terai sadaa naale ||3||
lines.translation: Thus says Nanak: wherever you go, O my mind, the Lord is there with you. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਥੰਮੑਿਆ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur miliai dhaavat tha(n)mhiaa nij ghar vasiaa aae ||
lines.translation: Meeting the True Guru, the wandering mind is held steady; it comes to abide in its own home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਹਾਝੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam vihaajhe naam lae naam rahe samaae ||
lines.translation: It purchases the Naam, chants the Naam, and remains absorbed in the Naam.
